propositions: High-centrality, low-headroom modules near the 800-LOC cap block ordinary changes, so they must be relieved ahead of the work that touches them.
llm/config.py is extracted into a new gate_context.py to regain real headroom, unblocking d23e's deprecation alias without a structural prerequisite.
llm/plan_review/workflow_ops.py is split into decide_ops.py to drop under the 560-LOC target.
Seam tests assert per-file headroom bounds (config.py under 700 LOC) as a substitute ratchet since the per-function length gate was rejected as too high blast radius.
New static guards assert full plan-review step-registry membership and that every 'uses:' in gates/plan-review.yaml resolves in STEP_REGISTRY.
gen_env_registry.py must be clean and complete after registering the previously invisible _llm_float helper so no env var is missing from docs.
